content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: on the Item (list) screen, users scroll the list repeatedly (scroll events on \"Item 190\" up to 7850 px) and then click the \"Item 190\" row, which is followed about 100-150 ms later by a navigation back to accounts receivable:report, so the list row appears to route back to the report instead of staying on the item. A console error also fires within about 200-300 ms of arriving on Item (list) in all three sessions.", "fix": "Fix: on the Item (list) screen, change the \"Item 190\" row click handler (the div at about x 1250-1300, y 250-275) so it opens the item rather than navigating to accounts receivable:report, and fix the console error thrown when item:list mounts so the list renders without the brief overlay.", "cited_event_ids": ["app:1", "12", "54", "70", "app:2", "403", "446", "464", "405", "447"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The text of the console errors is not in the events, so the failing code path is unknown.", "The user's intent on Item (list) is not observable; the return to the report may be deliberate.", "Whether the Item 190 element is a link or a handler that calls a route back to the report is inferred from the navigation that follows the click, not from the DOM.", "Dropped pointer samples (96-155 per session) may hide some hover or click behaviour.", "The overlay content and why it appears for about 20 ms are not in the events.", "Coverage gaps list is empty, so no additional screens were checked."]}
